entry.title: Driftwater 1.0.0
entry.summary: # Driftwater 1.0.0 Driftwater adds a drifting stereo delay to guitar, keys, drums, or other input. Rate, Damp and Depth shape its motion. LPG lets transients brighten the wet signal, and Mix blends the wet and dry paths. Main has five knobs, and Info explains the controls and credits the Fairfield Circuitry Shallow Water. ## Compatibility and validation External Plugin Support on MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. Use the ARMv7 archive on Gen 1 and the AArch64 archive on Gen 2. Both archives passed the Ope
